GOAL: make the FINAL tip byte-identical to `qemu-isa-match` EXCEPT the sanctioned legacy in the spec's expected_delta_vs_old_tip — the reconstruction dropped some test coverage that must be restored at the commits that OWN those files.

WORKSPACE RULES: work ONLY in that worktree, branch review/vsim-series. NEVER 'git push'. NEVER touch /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim's main checkout or other worktrees or other branches. Read-only git against the repo is fine. If any rebase step goes wrong, 'git rebase --abort' and report — do NOT leave a half-rebased branch.

CONTEXT: The series was built prototype-first (minimal slice then completion). Completion commits are supposed to bring each file to its FINAL form (minus features that land in still-later commits). Some completion commits under-restored their TEST files, so the tip lost these vs qemu-isa-match:
1. src/tests/platform/simple_memory.test.cpp — lost TEST_CASE 'simple_memory can access the final word of the region' (the 05f2750 final-word fix guard).
2. tests/hybrid/v_regfile_xfer.test.cpp — dropped 6->3 cases; lost the 3 'for_each_transport_csr' tests (honors caps / honors block flags / walks Andes+PMA+M-ext canonical order) and 'stage packs registers contiguously at vlenb stride'.
3. tests/hybrid/state_drain.test.cpp — lost 'drain reads GPRs and FPRs via abstract reads only -- no PB' guard case (29->28).
4. tests/hybrid/program_buffer.test.cpp — lost 'encode_lwu: known encodings (golden hex ...)' case (18->17).
5. src/hybrid/andes_caps.hpp — byte-identical to old tip but the sanctioned 'CSR sweep' text fix at ~lines 76 and 88 was never applied (change 'CSR sweep' wording to the abstract-path wording used elsewhere, e.g. resume_driver.hpp; match how state_drain.hpp was fixed).

METHOD (surgical, honest history):
a. First, get the COMPLETE picture: for EVERY tracked file, 'git -C <wt> diff qemu-isa-match HEAD -- <file>' — build the full list of files that differ. Cross-check against expected_delta_vs_old_tip (deleted + edited_only + the 14 known pybind11-fallout cpu_wrappers/sim_control/cpu_signal_registry files which are sanctioned deletion-only). ANY file that differs and is NOT explained by sanctioned legacy is a defect to fix — do not fix only the 5 above; find all of them (especially *.test.cpp with fewer TEST_CASEs than qemu-isa-match).
b. For each defective file, find the LAST commit in 03dfe23..HEAD that touches it: 'git -C <wt> log --oneline 03dfe23..HEAD -- <file>'. That commit is where the file reaches final form. The fix = at that commit, replace the file with the FULL final-tree content: 'git checkout qemu-isa-match -- <file>' (for andes_caps.hpp apply only the text fix, keeping it otherwise identical since it IS byte-identical — actually just 'git checkout qemu-isa-match -- <file>' won't help since it's identical; instead hand-edit the two 'CSR sweep' comments).
c. Restore via interactive rebase: GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR to mark the owning commits 'edit', then at each stop, 'git checkout qemu-isa-match -- <file>' (or hand-edit andes_caps.hpp), verify it COMPILES + its test PASSES at that commit's ABI pin (g++ -std=c++20 -I /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/abi/vN -I /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/external/doctest/doctest -I <wt>/src <test> -o /tmp/claude-1002/vrep && /tmp/claude-1002/vrep), 'git add', 'git commit --amend --no-edit', 'git rebase --continue'. Pick vN = the ABI pin in effect at that commit (check the gitlink / whether the test compiles at v3/v4/v5/v6; the full final test may require the ABI version where its feature exists — if the last-touch commit is BEFORE that ABI pin and the restored test won't compile, the correct owning commit is the FIRST commit at/after the needed ABI pin that touches the file, or the file's feature-completion commit; use judgment and verify compile).
   - IMPORTANT: if restoring the full final test at the last-touch commit fails to compile because it needs a later feature/ABI, move the restore to the earliest later commit where it DOES compile, or (only if unavoidable) note it. Prefer the natural owning completion commit.
d. After the rebase, VERIFY: 'git -C <wt> diff qemu-isa-match HEAD --stat' shows ONLY sanctioned-legacy differences (quote the full list); then recompile+run EVERY tests/hybrid/*.test.cpp at the tip against abi/v6 (skip SystemC-linked shared_mem_smoke/offset). All pass.
